column3: MT 69:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. The Hebrew title has “of David”; NASB adds “A Psalm” and sets the title in braces. “The waters have come up to the neck” is rendered “the waters have threatened my life.”
Close to the Hebrew; “numerous” is rendered “powerful,” and “falsehood” as “wrongfully.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my guilts” is rendered “my wrongs.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Lord Yahweh” is rendered “Lord GOD.”
Close to the Hebrew; “because of You” is rendered “for Your sake.”
Close to the Hebrew; “taunt songs of the drinkers” is rendered “I am the song of the drunkards.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the faithfulness of Your salvation” is rendered “with Your saving truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I waited for sympathy” is rendered “I looked for sympathy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “poison” is rendered “gall.”
“For the allies” (those at peace) is rendered “when they are in peace,” and the words “snare” and “trap” are exchanged.
Close to the Hebrew; “scroll” is rendered “book.”
